samples.title: Phân loại rác
samples.prompt: Your friend has invited you to a neighbourhood recycling workshop. Accept the invitation, explain your travel plans, and ask about preparation while offering help.
requirementsVi: Nhận lời rõ ràng.
Nêu cách đến và giờ hẹn.

samples.summaryVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Nhận lời
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for inviting me to a neighbourhood recycling workshop. I would love to come. I have been interested in sorting household waste for some time, so I am glad we will have a chance to explore it together.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cảm ơn và trả lời trực tiếp lời mời.

paragraphs.label: Đi lại
paragraphs.text: I can meet you at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. I am planning to take the bus and arrive ten minutes early. If the time or meeting point changes, please send me a message before I leave home.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lịch hẹn và phương án cập nhật.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị và hỗ trợ
paragraphs.text: I understand that we will practise sorting common household items. I can bring a few clean empty containers, but could you let me know if anything else is needed? One useful point is that more recyclable material can be collected separately. For example, a family can keep a small box for clean bottles instead of putting them in the same bag as dinner leftovers. I would also be happy to help arrange the seats or hand out materials before the session begins.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỏi rõ chuẩn bị, nối với nội dung sự kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
Thanks again for thinking of me. It will be lovely to spend time together and learn something practical. Let me know whether you would like me to arrive earlier to help.

Best wishes,
Minh
paragraphs.noteVi: Thể hiện thiện chí và chốt.
